item.title: NHB: Arbitrators must be independent; report action to NHB
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · RBI DoR.CO.BCG(MCS).No.S6464/01.01.008/2026-27

Effective 2026-11-12.

Who it covers: Banks and NBFCs, including HFCs.

  • After a Delhi High Court order of 30-09-2026, RBI cautioned lenders against appointing the same arbitrators unilaterally across many disputes.
  • Arbitrators are to be appointed only in line with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and court rulings on independence and neutrality.
  • HFCs report the action taken to NHB.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Branch notice: insurance is voluntary and not linked to a loan
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DOS/DAK/2026/05646

Effective 2026-09-24.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • Every branch must display, in English and Hindi or the State's language, a notice that buying insurance is voluntary and not linked to any loan.
  • The notice board should be at least 2 feet by 2 feet; NHB gives suggested wording.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Fraud monitoring returns to be filed with NHB
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DOS/DAK/2026/05615

Effective 2026-09-07.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • FMR-1 for every fraud within 14 days of classification; FMR-2 and FMR-3 on CRaMIS within 15 days of each quarter end.
  • Theft, burglary, dacoity and robbery reported within 7 days in FMR-4.
  • Frauds in unregulated group entities are also reported to NHB; withdrawal or closure of an FMR needs NHB's approval.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Interest only from actual disbursement; cancelled cheques not loans
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DOS/DAK/2026/05489

Effective 2026-07-24.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • Keep the borrower's acknowledgement of cheque or draft handover, with instrument details.
  • Cancelled instruments must not be shown as loans in NHB returns or financial statements.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Accurate CERSAI filings and periodic reconciliation
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DoS/DoC/2026/05473

Effective 2026-07-17.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • CERSAI found wrong borrower, property and address data, including records naming people who never borrowed.
  • HFCs must set internal controls and reconcile CERSAI data periodically.

Official source

item.title: NHB: 1600xx only for service calls; 140xx for promotional calls
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DOS/DAK/2026/05419

Effective 2026-07-07.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • 1600xx numbers may be used only for service and transactional calls, never for marketing.
  • Promotional calls only from 140xx numbers.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Complaints flowchart on the website
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DOS/DAK/2026/05396

Effective 2026-06-29.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • A flowchart under the website's 'Complaint' section must show how to complain, the escalation route and the officers who handle grievances.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Penal and bounce charges not to raise revenue
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DOS/DAK/2026/05245

Effective 2026-04-23.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • Inspections found bounce charges on top of penal charges for the same default and visit charges recovering costs already in the lending rate.
  • The Board policy on penal and similar charges must be reviewed.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Grievance officer details on website and in branches
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DOS/DAK/2026/05202

Effective 2026-04-07.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • Full contact details of grievance redressal officers on the website.
  • The complaint procedure displayed in every branch and office.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Monthly report of prime lending rate components
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · HO/DOS/DAK/2026/05181

Effective 2026-04-01.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • Component-wise prime lending rate or benchmark rate data to NHB every month, by the 10th, from 01-04-2026.

Official source

item.title: NHB: KYC lapses found in inspections
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · MRO/DOS/DOC/2026/05157

Effective 2026-03-05.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • Inspections found late CKYCR uploads, late periodic updation and identification lapses.
  • HFCs must comply strictly with the RBI NBFC KYC Directions, 2025.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Accessibility for persons with disabilities
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · MRO/DOS/DOC/2026/05106

Effective 2026-01-30.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • HFCs must follow RBI's accessibility instructions in the NBFC conduct and KYC Directions, 2025, which implement the Supreme Court's directives of 30-04-2025 on accessible digital KYC.

Official source

item.title: NHB: New refinance booklet for lenders
item.description:
NHB · Refinance · NHB Refinance Booklet (w.e.f. 15-12-2025)

Effective 2025-12-15.

Who it covers: HFCs, banks and co-operative lenders that borrow refinance from NHB.

  • One booklet now sets the terms of all refinance schemes, including eligibility, security, repayment, prepayment and returns.
  • CEO and CFO certify the flagged loan pool every quarter within 15 days; late payment over 3 working days carries a 2% penal charge.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Digital services to meet IS 17802 accessibility standards
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · MRO/DOS/DOC/2025/04973

Effective 2025-12-12.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • Websites, apps and devices to meet IS 17802 Parts I and II before the standard is made mandatory.

Official source

item.title: NHB: Service calls only from 1600-series numbers
item.description:
NHB · Advisory · MRO/DOS/DOC/2025/04967

Effective 2025-12-11.

Who it covers: All registered HFCs.

  • Transactional and service calls only from 1600-series numbers: by 01-02-2026 for HFCs with assets above Rs 5,000 crore, by 01-03-2026 for others.

Official source

item.title: NHB: NHB Grievance Redressal Policy (GRIDS)
item.description:
NHB · Policy · NHB Grievance Redressal Policy, version 1.7

Effective 2025-12-01.

Who it covers: Customers of HFCs and the HFCs themselves.

  • A customer may complain to NHB on GRIDS if the HFC does not reply within one month or its reply is unsatisfactory; NHB aims to resolve complaints within 21 days.
  • Appeals within 30 days of closure, decided within 15 days.

Official source
